⚠ // PROTOCOL NOTICE // NOSTR KEY CUSTODY
1. UN-CENSORABLE GOSSIP PROPAGATION:
Nostr is an open relay gossip network. Events signed and published cannot be recalled once gossiped to independent relays.
2. ABSOLUTE KEY CUSTODY:
Your nsec is your master cryptographic identity. Pennant signs notes locally inside the memory-scrubbed enclave and never transmits private keys across the wire.
